eps.o: When Bill is disappointed with his tiny pumpkins, Tilly steals an alien compound to make them grow.
Gloria tries to maintain her cafe's perfect rating by leaving Cricket in charge while she is away.
Bill forces his family to embrace a 'Live, Laugh, Love' philosophy.
Cricket mentors a wild child, and Tilly develops a cult following.
Nancy tries to prove herself on the farm. Bill struggles to relax at a fancy spa with Gramma.
Cricket is halted at a convenience store due to their "No Shoes, No Service" policy.
When Remy throws Vasquez a surprise party, Bill’s secret-keeping is put to the test.
Tilly and Bill set off on an epic journey to recycle a fluorescent light bulb at an e-waste center.
Tilly tries to solve a long-standing feud between Gramma and Mr. Grigorian.
Cricket wants to prove to his family that he isn’t dumb during trivia night at the café.
Tilly gets punished for the first time and decides to break bad.
Bill tries too hard to impress a neighbor. Tilly investigates a sock conspiracy.
Cricket races against a robot to save his delivery job, while Gramma fights an ant infestation!
Cricket loses his hearing and keeps it a secret from Bill.
The Greens go to a hipster drive-in movie, where Gloria proves her life is fun by taking the perfect Snap-A-Gram photo.
Remy is determined to be a martial arts warrior after freezing in the face of danger.
Cricket’s missing dirt jar prompts the story of when the Greens left their country farm.
The Greens struggle to readjust to country life.
While Cricket shows Remy the fun of country life, Tilly seeks new sleeping arrangements.
Cricket tries to win back his old country friend, Hector.
Remy attempts to find his "country grit" while Cricket takes tractor-driving lessons.
Phoenix journeys back to Big City to retrieve Saxon while Gramma and Gloria go to a club.
Gramma challenges the local diner owner to a "pie-off" to see whose pie is Tilly’s favorite.
Nancy tries to get Cricket to cut his new rat tail without admitting that she hates it.
Tilly makes changes to her coming-of-age ceremony.
Cricket fast-tracks his training for a rodeo and gets trapped in a never-ending montage.
A pizza delivery girl from Big City must flee from a crazed country family, not knowing they just want their pizza.
Tilly tries to hide how much she hates horses when Bill gets a horse for the day.

When Cricket gets snowed in at the Remingtons on Christmas Eve he attempts to recreate the Greens Christmas Eve traditions in a virtual reality video game but must hide the game's true nature from his family.
Tilly and Andromeda exchange letters that reveal their unique outlooks on the world.
Remy enlists the Greens to help him lie to his parents about his week in the country.
The kids plan a heist to steal honey from Bill’s beehive.
Cricket and Remy run a campaign to get Phoenix the dog elected as mayor.
Cricket discovers lake life brings out Bill's fun-loving side.
When rabbits threaten to destroy Bill's crops, Nancy enlists their country friends to save the harvest.
When the Greens return Gramma and Remy to Big City, they are determined to delay their goodbye for as long as possible.
